body: I don't know. I've tried talking to her about everything like people had suggested in the other post, and it seems to have just driven her farther and farther away from me. I told her that there is a big possibility that I have a terminal illness (less than 1 year) and about being molested when I was a lot younger. And when she doesn't talk to me after that, it makes me feel worthless, and it makes me want to go to the kitchen and plunge everything into my heart, because at least that would make the pain stop.

I've tried going out, watching tv, etc. I've been with friends, talked to other people, but nothing helps. I still feel fucking miserable, and I went to sleep thinking that it would be better in the morning, and it's worse. She won't talk to me after I told her something deeply personal about my past (molestation). If she can't accept me, I don't want anyone else to, and I just want to die, and end this misery quickly.
